text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has sunk her fangs into<n>the Twinkle
Series and left a lasting<n>mark with great results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully<n>navigated the crucial
first three years<n>of her career. But...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My examination's finally done... Man,<n>do I hate the
smell of hospitals!
choice_data_list: I'm glad it was just a minor injury.
I'm glad it was just a minor injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the racing she's done has taken a<n>small toll on
her feet. But the doctor<n>said there shouldn't be a
problem if<n>she stays off them for a week or two.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lackey! I can't walk with these!<n>Can't even pull
off any pranks...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Why do I gotta miss trainin'<n>when my feet
don't even hurt?
choice_data_list: So that you can run as much as you like later on.
So that you can run as much as you like later on.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No fair!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she's free from the crutches<n>after just a
few days, she has to<n>continue tending to her legs
for a long<n>while after that.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy! Is anything troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We heard you had to take a break<n>from racing,
dearie. If there's<n>anything you need, just say it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wow... You guys are real nice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! We all saw how hard<n>you've pushed
yourself, Windy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! ♪ I'm so glad your injury's<n>no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Right? Meanwhile, Trainer's been all<n>like, "You've
gotta get your rest."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mrgh! There isn't even anything to<n>worry about.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hold up... This seems strangely<n>familiar...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Trainer also suggested I<n>take it easy
back when my legs were<n>in danger of getting
swollen...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ohhh? Sounds like you've got a great<n>trainer to me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mngh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me... I'd say that's the<n>reason you got
through these three<n>years. Because you actually
did take<n>it slow when you needed to.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I agree... Your trainer helped make<n>your journey
here as smooth as<n>possible. Heehee... And they're
doing<n>it again right now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-ngh... That's not...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Well, I did choose Trainer to be mydiabolical strategist.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I know a good lackey when I see<n>'em! Heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haha! Whatcha gettin' proud of<n>yourself for?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Your trainer's amazing, so don't<n>forget to let them
know you're<n>grateful from time to time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Why do I gotta do something<n>embarrassin'
like that?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Good manners and common courtesy<n>are
extremely important. Professor<n>Veggie from Carrot
Ranger said so!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr! But... BUT!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is my lackey—my subservient<n>underling! You
don't need to say<n>thanks to people who are
beneath<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But... I guess offering a tiny reward<n>couldn't hurt...
Subordinates like<n>stickers, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Or... you could just thank them<n>normally.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you think about it, now is the<n>perfect time for you
to turn over a<n>new leaf and start expressing your
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right? And if you miss your chance<n>now, it might be
harder in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after our trip to the<n>hospital, Shinko
Windy suddenly<n>invites me to meet her out of the
blue.
choice_data_list: (I wonder what she wanted me to come here for...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Lackey... You got here right on time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: U-up?! Why would anything be up?!<n>I... I mean...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Isn't this place just beautiful?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Flowers... as far as you can see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The flower beds really are pretty. I'm<n>enjoying the
breeze, too. Is this what<n>she wanted to show me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
When I talked it over with Mom, she<n>told me
flowers were the way to go.<n>Said roses would be
especially good...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: B-but let's walk a little first! We can<n>chat after!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a leisurely stroll, we arrive at an<n>observation
deck. I'm worried by<n>how far we've traveled,
though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yup! A-okay!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Doc told me now's the time to start<n>walking and
going on light jogs. In<n>other words, this is part of
my<n>recovery.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeesh, you're such a worrywart...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Actually, no, I mean... you're r-really<n>caring... you
know...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're always... thinking about my<n>well-being...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So, uh... you see... us being together<n>for three years
now... um...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mngh... This is so hard!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She nods a few times. I take the<n>flowers from her,
but it's so out of<n>the blue that I have no idea what
to<n>say.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nope! No pranks! I swear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This time's different... They're just<n>regular
flowers...
choice_data_list: What brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's not "all of a sudden." C'mon...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We've been running together this<n>whole time,
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't think... I would've ever made<n>it this far on
my own.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I probably would've crashed and<n>burned
somewhere along the way if it<n>weren't for you...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm giving you your flowers—a<n>little reward for
being a good little<n>lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And... um... you know...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Thank... you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her faint voice fades quickly into the<n>blue sky, but
before it does, I manage<n>to catch those two magical
words of<n>hers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To say that she's been a handful<n>these past three
years would be an<n>understatement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But even so, I want to keep staying<n>by her
side—until her ambition<n>becomes her reality.
